name: Question 7
problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $M$ given by

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}4 & -4 & -12 & 8 \\ -1 & 1 & 10 & -5 \\ 0 & 3 & -9 & -6\end{aligned}].
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form.
worked_solution:
Reducing $M$ to row echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼[\begin{aligned}4 & -4 & -12 & 8 \\ -1 & 1 & 10 & -5 \\ 0 & 3 & -9 & -6\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :=\frac{1}{4}{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & -3 & 2 \\ -1 & 1 & 10 & -5 \\ 0 & 3 & -9 & -6\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & -3 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 7 & -3 \\ 0 & 3 & -9 & -6\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Note that we get ${a}_{22}=0.$ Therefore, we swap the $2$nd and $3$rd rows:

$$
\begin{aligned} & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & -3 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 7 & -3 \\ 0 & 3 & -9 & -6\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & ↔{R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & -3 & 2 \\ 0 & 3 & -9 & -6 \\ 0 & 0 & 7 & -3\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we multiply the $2$nd row by $\frac{1}{3}$ and the $3$rd row by $\frac{1}{7}$ to get

$$
\begin{aligned} & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & -3 & 2 \\ 0 & 3 & -9 & -6 \\ 0 & 0 & 7 & -3\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :=\frac{1}{3}{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & -3 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & -3 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 7 & -3\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :=\frac{1}{7}{R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & -3 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & -3 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & -\frac{3}{7}\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Question 7
?

Consider the augmented matrix M given by M=[4−4−128−1110−503−9−6].

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix M of the system to row echelon form.

a
M∼[1−14−20114−700137]
b
M∼[1−1−320132001−7]
c
M∼[1−1−3201−3−2001−37]
d
M∼[1−1−3201−3−2001−3]
e
M∼[1−1−4201−2−3001−37]
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

Reducing M to row echelon form, we have

M∼[4−4−128−1110−503−9−6]R1:=14R1∼[1−1−32−1110−503−9−6]R2:=R2+R1∼[1−1−32007−303−9−6].

Note that we get a22=0. Therefore, we swap the 2nd and 3rd rows: M∼[1−1−32007−303−9−6]R2↔R3∼[1−1−3203−9−6007−3]

Finally, we multiply the 2nd row by 13 and the 3rd row by 17 to get M∼[1−1−3203−9−6007−3]R2:=13R2∼[1−1−3201−3−2007−3]R3:=17R3∼[1−1−3201−3−2001−37].
